The '''Yutan system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located within the [[Ombakond sector/Legends|Ombakond sector]], a part of the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] regions known as the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]<ref name="EAOC" /> and [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]].<ref name="TEA" /> The system was the origin point of the [[Middle Yutanese]] [[Language/Legends|language]].<ref name="CNIII">''[[Coruscant Nights III: Patterns of Force]]''</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=[[Middle Yutanese]]|system=Yutan [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Yutan system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the system in grid square P-12.<ref name="TEA" />
